text:
nora: Heads-up — we started seeing a token-mix shift around 09:12 UTC. streaming sessions increased and median context jumped.

devin: Can you share numbers? :eyes:

nora: Quick snapshot:
```
window: last 3h
streaming qps: 95 -> 320
median ctx len: 1.1k -> 5.8k
p50 latency (streaming): 80ms -> 230ms
estimated GPU hours/day (if trend holds): 640 -> 2380
``` 

maya: ouch. Is this tied to a product rollout or promotion?

nora: Product doesn't show a rollout flag. Looks like organic traffic from an external bot net and some customer apps toggled streaming by default.

infra-bot: Alert generated: "long-context streaming surge" (severity: medium). Autoscale triggered +1 pool in us-west-2.

devin: If the context distribution stays high we blow past our committed Dedicated capacity in 3 days. Need a forecast for 7/30/90 day windows and a hedge plan.

nora: Draft forecast (if 3x sustained streaming mix, conservative):
- 7d: GPU hrs/day ~ 2k (peak 2.6k)
- 30d: GPU hrs/day ~ 1.8k (avg, assuming partial reversion)
- 90d: uncertain — baseline could normalize or stay +50% depending on adoption

nora: Costs quick calc: incremental GPU $/day ~ (2k-640)*$2.8 = ~$3.8k/day (guesstimate, binarized types)

maya: Ops options?

devin: Short list:
- prewarm extra streaming nodes in us-west-2 + us-east-1 for 72h (cheap hedge)
- tighten autoscale cooldowns and add a target CPU/kv-hit metric
- enable aggressive KV prefix caching for heavy chat flows
- for customers hitting long contexts, fall back to 8k-quantized variant when latency > 200ms

ops: We can schedule prewarm tomorrow 04:00 UTC. How many nodes?

nora: Start with 8 extra V100-equivalent slots (est ~ +400 GPU-hrs/day) and monitor. If surge keeps going, escalate to 24.

sam_h: I'll open a quick runbook: prewarm script + alert thresholds + cost cap play. Also will draft a one-pager to Sales so they can triage high-ctx customers.

devin: Also add a brief rollback: switch streaming TTL to 8s and reduce continuous-batching window from 200ms -> 100ms if latency climbs.

maya: Any networking concerns? We saw a small spike in egress at ~09:30.

nora: Egress aligns with streaming ramp. No packet loss, but some peering links at 65% util. Ops: throttle non-critical background syncs for the next 12h?

ops: Ack — will push a policy to deprioritize non-prod replication for 12h. Scheduling prewarm at 04:00 UTC tomorrow.

infra-bot: Action items logged: PREWARM-185567-01, THROTTLE-NONPROD-185567, RUNBOOK-185567.

sam_h: Thanks — let's reconvene in the morning after the prewarm window. If anyone sees repeat ramps, call pager.

devin: I'll drop the 7d rolling forecast into the capacity dashboard and set an alert at 1.5x current committed.

nora: Thanks all. Will post a follow-up with a tiny analysis of request patterns (who toggled streaming) in the next message.

ops: :thumbsup:
